response.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(*)::numeric / AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM riskandmargin AS rm JOIN orders AS o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope
